text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending removal of an on-street accessible loading zone on Harvie Avenue. The accessible loading zone was originally installed in 2017 based on a request from a local resident. Staff have since been made aware that the accessible loading zone is no longer required.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing accessible loading zone in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Harvie Avenue, between a point 46.1 metres south of Morrison Avenue and a point 11 metres further south.
